executiveSummary: DGO Digital OPS is a DGCEO-coordinated operational control platform for managing official correspondences, registry minutes, assignments, departmental tasks, response tracking, approvals, dispatch, closure and archive across the Agency.

ingestionSources.label: Physical documents received and scanned
ingestionSources.description: Official hard-copy documents received by the Agency, scanned and ingested for registry, minutes, assignment and tracking.

ingestionSources.label: Customer Service emails
ingestionSources.description: Emails received by customer service that require review, assignment, response tracking, escalation, closure or archive.

ingestionSources.label: Public portal submissions
ingestionSources.description: Correspondences submitted from public-facing portals and routed into intake, registry and task assignment.

ingestionSources.label: DGCEO outgoing correspondence
ingestionSources.description: Outgoing DGCEO letters, directives, approvals, minutes and instructions requiring dispatch, tracking, closure and archive.

users: Executive Assistant / Automation Support to the DGCEO
corePurposes: Single point of access to all four ingestion sources
Task assignment from all ingestion sources
End-to-end lifecycle tracking and management of operations and tasks
Related operational oversight, reporting, audit and accountability purposes
principle: The platform must be judged by whether a user can receive or locate a matter from any ingestion source, register it, minute it, assign it, track it, review it, dispatch it, close it and archive it without confusion.
